entries.fc7b48d6b7420b3c: This service handles interior construction at commercial facilities and stores, carrying in and installing furniture and fixtures and interior work when offices relocate, assembling and installing furniture, and lifting building materials. It is experienced in handling simultaneous on-site work, such as simultaneous construction across multiple stores and simultaneous entry by multiple contractors, and it flexibly combines full-time employees with a large number of registered staff to respond to sites that need many workers in a short period. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended September 2025 was ¥4,551 million.
entries.fcc999e7efc43d9d: The business is a single segment of construction service-related business. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended September 2025 was spread across four services: construction services for commercial environments at ¥4,551 million, repair services at ¥4,493 million, construction services for residential environments at ¥4,148 million, and product sales at ¥667 million. As for the operating environment, while the number of newly built housing starts is declining, demand in the maintenance and renovation market, which aims to keep existing buildings comfortable for longer, and in the commercial environment market is said to be firm.
